gates.mechanism: one tick function, every 10 ticks (the shape of tools/route_trainers.py's cycle): each player near the tower is tagged from their own stage by runmolang (q.player.data(), the store tools/compile_dialogue.py's conversations write), then a player inside a gated box without the tag is set back where the gate stands, with one actionbar line. Per player: one player's stage moves nobody else. No block is ever opened or shut, so a player inside walks out through the open doorway whenever they like; creative and spectator pass.

fights_why: the integration of 2026-10-04: ONE Brann and ONE Elara, the NPCs above, who talk AND fight. Each NPC's class carries its data/finale_trainers.json team as a `simple` party (the conversation's npc_battle, tools/compile_dialogue.py), a choice in its conversation starts Cobblemon's own NPC battle (q.npc.start_battle(q.player, 'singles'), as the jar's dialogues/npc-example.json does), and this pack's battle_victory callback (data/cobblemon/callbacks/battle_victory/cobblers_hq_tower.molang) runs cobblers:hq_tower/<function> as each WINNING player when the losing NPC stands within `radius` of that NPC's `at` -- the arena's proven callback shape (docs/research/notes/arena-per-player-opponents.md section 8) keyed on the NPC's fixed spot instead of a tag, because R18HQ's placement tags nothing. The function writes `sets` into that player's Cobblemon data by runmolang, as tools/route_trainers.py's won functions do. A loss runs nothing here (the blackout pack's own battle_victory callback handles a loss to an NPC, as for any trainer)
